column2: Table 5b.  U.S. Regional Natural Gas Prices  (dollars per thousand cubic feet)
U.S. Energy Information Administration  |  Short-Term Energy Outlook  - October 2026
(a) For a list of states in each region see "Census division" in EIA’s Energy Glossary (http://www.eia.gov/glossary/index.html).
EIA completed modeling and analysis for this report on Thursday, October 1, 2026.
The approximate break between historical and forecast values is shown with historical data with no shading; estimates and forecasts are shaded gray.
Minor discrepancies with published historical data are due to independent rounding.
Prices are not adjusted for inflation.
Regions refer to U.S. Census divisions.

Historical data: Latest data available from Energy Information Administration databases supporting the Natural Gas Monthly. Henry Hub spot price is from Refinitiv,an LSEG company, via EIA (https://www.eia.gov/dnav/pet/pet_pri_spt_s1_d.htm).
Forecasts: EIA Short-Term Integrated Forecasting System.
